description: Source code for MockCryptoClientStream class implementing a mock QUIC crypto client stream with methods for handshake simulation, encryption setup, and session management.

classes.name: MockCryptoClientStream
classes.description: A mock implementation of a QUIC crypto client stream for testing handshake and encryption behaviors.

methods.name: MockCryptoClientStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock crypto client stream with session, config, and handshake mode.

methods.name: OnHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming handshake messages, here simulating an error.

methods.name: CryptoConnect
methods.description: Simulates the crypto connection process, setting up encryption and session state based on handshake mode.

methods.name: encryption_established
methods.description: Returns whether encryption has been established.

methods.name: one_rtt_keys_available
methods.description: Returns whether 1-RTT keys are available, indicating handshake completion.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Indicates if early data was accepted (stubbed as false).

methods.name: crypto_message_parser
methods.description: Provides access to the crypto message parser.

methods.name: OnOneRttPacketAcknowledged
methods.description: Stub for handling acknowledgment of 1-RTT packets.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Creates a decrypter for current 1-RTT keys.

methods.name: NotifySessionZeroRttComplete
methods.description: Notifies session that 0-RTT handshake is complete, setting up decrypters.

methods.name: NotifySessionOneRttKeyAvailable
methods.description: Notifies session that 1-RTT keys are available, updating session state.

methods.name: GetDummyCHLOMessage
methods.description: Returns a dummy Client Hello message.

methods.name: SetConfigNegotiated
methods.description: Configures transport parameters and updates session after negotiation.
